purpose: Create a bounded event/revenue baseline for the $TRUMP launch so later rhetoric, access, unlock, and policy events can be compared against the first monetization episode without presuming motive or manipulation.

events.event: First mint time displayed for the verified $TRUMP Solana token by Solscan.
events.limit: Underlying mint-creation transaction signature/instructions not yet custodied.

events.event: Donald Trump publicly announced the official $TRUMP meme, directed readers to obtain it, and linked the official product site.
events.limit: Exact platform-origin machine timestamp remains to be independently custodied.

events.event: The Block Research reports the earliest $TRUMP liquidity pool was deployed at approximately this time, with FDV slightly above $700,000.
events.limit: Must be reproduced from the on-chain pool-creation transaction before being treated as authoritative.

events.event: $TRUMP reached a reported peak overall market value above $14.5 billion before subsequently falling materially.
Melania Trump publicly announced $MELANIA; Donald Trump re-Truthed the announcement shortly afterward.
events.observed_market_lead: The Block Research reports $TRUMP fell more than 48% following the $MELANIA launch alongside a broader market pullback.

events.event: End of the first Reuters/Merkle Science/Chainalysis fee-estimation window.

price_and_inventory.interpretation: Price appreciation can increase the marked value of retained affiliate inventory, but unrealized inventory value must remain separate from realized sales/fees.

trading_fees.interpretation: The project generated a large fee surface within two weeks. Official materials state affiliated entities receive trading revenue; precise beneficiary split remains unresolved.

token_sales_first_half_2025.interpretation: Token-sale proceeds are a distinct monetization channel from fees and inventory revaluation; ERL has not independently reproduced the sales estimate.

reuters_first_half_project_total.interpretation: The 50% allocation is an analytical assumption used by Reuters because the public project terms did not specify the Trump Organization percentage. It must not be represented as a disclosed contract term.

network_spillover.interpretation: The launch created an observable candidate spillover into Solana usage, SOL demand/price, DEX volume, wallets and crypto-app adoption. Causal share requires controls.

bounded_creator_wallet_target.reporting_basis: Reuters reports Merkle Science identified the three earliest holder wallets as receiving the initial tranche directly from creators without purchase; Chainalysis assessed the addresses belong to creators.
bounded_creator_wallet_target.research_value: This converts wallet discovery from an open-ended attribution exercise into a reproducible graph problem starting with the mint and first 200 million-token distribution.

candidate_response_function.core_reason: A price-only event study would miss monetization through turnover, fees and token sales. The launch baseline shows why beneficiary analysis must decompose each channel.

controls_and_falsifiers: Compare $TRUMP with matched meme coins experiencing similar market-wide risk-on conditions but no Trump promotion.
Control for BTC, SOL and broad memecoin-sector returns in each event window.
Separate launch/promotion effects from exchange listings, liquidity additions, unlocks and platform outages.
Include Trump posts about unrelated subjects and crypto-related remarks with no measurable $TRUMP response.
Include adverse or null policy events affecting Trump-linked crypto interests.
Do not infer manipulation from fee generation, concentrated ownership, price appreciation or retail losses alone.
Do not infer personal realization of project revenue where beneficiary percentages are undisclosed.
next_required_reconstruction: mint-creation transaction signature and instruction trace
first 200 million-token distribution transaction graph and the three creator-wallet addresses
first Meteora pool identity, creation transaction and initial funding
5-minute or finer TRUMP/SOL/BTC price-volume-liquidity panel beginning before the launch announcement
allocation/unlock schedule and subsequent unlock transaction chronology
event panel for March promotion, April dinner/leaderboard announcement, dinner date and later policy events
